root_cause.text: The `dpu_runtime_suspend` function in the MSM DPU driver incorrectly drops the performance state vote to zero using `dev_pm_opp_set_rate(dev, 0)`, which lowers the MMCX rail voltage while the core clock frequency remains at its original high rate, leading to a voltage-frequency mismatch upon runtime resume.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff removes `dev_pm_opp_set_rate(dev, 0)` from `dpu_runtime_suspend` in `drivers/gpu/drm/msm/disp/dpu1/dpu_kms.c`, and the commit message explains that this call "drops the MMCX rail to MIN_SVS while the core clock frequency remains at its original (highest) rate," causing a mismatch where "the rail cannot sustain the clock rate" when the power is re-enabled.
